```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 12, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

fig <- ggplot(indicators, aes(x = population_65_plus_pct, y = housing_non_main_pct)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2171b5", size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#b2182b", fill = "#b2182b", alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Envelliment i habitatge no principal als municipis del Tarragonès (2021)",
    x = "Població de 65 anys o més (%)",
    y = "Habitatge no principal (%)",
    caption = "Font: Idescat, cens de 2021 i habitatges per tipus d'habitatge, 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit()

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/project-ageing-vs-housing-scatter-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 5.5, device = svglite::svglite)

labels <- indicators[indicators$municipality %in% c("Salou", "Tarragona", "Vila-seca"), ]
bubbles <- ggplot(
  indicators,
  aes(
    x = population_65_plus_pct,
    y = housing_non_main_pct,
    size = population_total
  )
) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "#4C78A8", color = "#0B3A6E", alpha = 0.58, stroke = 0.45) +
  geom_text(
    data = labels,
    aes(
      x = population_65_plus_pct,
      y = housing_non_main_pct,
      label = municipality
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    nudge_y = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 24,
    breaks = c(500, 5000, 25000, 100000),
    labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    name = "Població total"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title = "Envelliment, habitatge no principal i població total (2021)",
    x = "Població de 65 anys o més (%)",
    y = "Habitatge no principal (%)",
    caption = "L'àrea de cada bombolla és proporcional a la població total. Font: Idescat, 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, nrow = 1)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = 8, b = 2)
  )

bubble_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/project-ageing-housing-population-bubbles-tarragones-2021.svg")
ggsave(bubble_output, bubbles, width = 8, height = 5.8, device = svglite::svglite)
```
